newCase.name: RAW F_H response pair: an explicit conditional root grant and one exact basis/Run/pending/hold/open seed let the actual preparers yield one six-field response fact and its combined prior admission, refused as an orphan or with a crossed source, ref, digest or order, alike over repeated reads, historical cuts, a fresh frozen clone and unrelated growth
newCase.premise: Conditional immutable RAW reader data. Each row was stamped by the actual store.projectRuntimeEventFromValidatedHistory over the rows before it, deep-frozen, and selected by the actual selectValidatedRuntimeEventPrefix. The seed is not Event Store admission and not current root admission. Current invocation_admission.ts:781-800 accepts exactly one direct-invoke grant, and it was not invoked.

events: public_operation_admitted (run.invoke, variant direct, memberKey invoke, intrinsic invoke definitionDigest)
invocation_admitted (record body digest names the admission ref; capabilityGrants [response grant])
run_segment_opened (runId from the production run body digest)
c_call_opened (leaf; cCallDigest per isCCall identity; held cursor ref/digest)
traversal_route_admitted (hold; consumes the judgment; source = held cursor)
fh_interaction_opened (payload variant 0, no construction intent; caused by the hold route)

grant.contract: definitionKey {abg.operation.interaction.respond, approve}. definitionRef and definitionDigest come from selectIntrinsicPublicFunctionDefinition. The builder asserts that the packet's definitionKey and owner authorityRef equal the intrinsic definition's. capabilityRef = INTERACTION_OPERATION_CONTRACTS.respond.approve.metadata.capabilityRefs[0], and the builder asserts that list equals capabilityRefsForDefinition.
grant.rawDeclared: The operationContract catalog coordinate and the capabilityDefinition graph digest/ref values are RAW declarations; only their shape is checked, by publicContractCoordinateSchema through isCapabilityGrantValue.
grant.binding: actorRef, scopeRef/scopeDigest (workspace binding) and policyRef/policyDigest equal the rehydrated root's. Root capabilityGrants = [grant] and capabilityGrantRefs = [grantRef].
grant.checks: isCapabilityGrantValue(grant) is true. A copy with a foreign actorRef is false. No claim is made that current root admission produced this grant.

newCase.gatesInOrder: Each gate is absent one row before its cut and holds at its cut. invocation: rehydrateInvocationAdmissionAtPrefix, cut 2. basis: projectExactExecutionBasisAtPrefix, cut 3. run: hasExactInvocationRunBindingAtPrefix, cut 4. pending: projectPendingInteractionCarrier, cut 8. heldFluent: continuation_open + interaction_pending + frame_held, without continuation_response_available, on deriveRuntimeHeldFluentProjection over the Run selection, cut 10. openContinuation: projectFhContinuations returns exactly one open continuation, cut 10. Also asserted: hasAdmittedInvocationAtPrefix is true, constructionIntentRef is null, and actorCapabilityRef equals the grant capabilityRef.
newCase.availableBefore: At the seed prefix: response ref and unused ref are 'available'. The root invocation is 'duplicate', with priorAdmission equal to the single run.invoke fact. F_H facts = {valid, []}.

prepared.operation: prepareContinuationPublicOperation(P, root, interaction.respond, open continuation, 'approve', actor, capability, basis) returns kind prepared_continuation_public_operation. The operation equals the exact continuation_public_operation_admission record (capabilityGrantRef = grantRef). The event is public_operation_admitted at ordinal 11, with parentAggregateId = response ref, capabilityGrantRefs [grantRef] and invocationDigest = coordinate digest. projectedPrefix bodies = seed + event.
prepared.response: prepareFhInteractionResponse(prepared, continuation, responseContractRef, value, {same time/correlation, causes []}) returns kind prepared_fh_interaction_response, disposition responded. The event is fh_interaction_responded at ordinal 12, causes [opened, operation], with responseDigest = sha256Canonical(value). projectedPrefix bodies = seed + operation + response.

newCase.completedPair: projectFhEffectfulPublicInvocationFacts = {valid, [fact]}, exactly six keys. projectEffectfulPublicInvocationTruthAtPrefix(response ref) = duplicate, with priorAdmission deep-equal to fact. The unused ref is available. The root ref is duplicate, with the unchanged run.invoke fact. The prepared projectedPrefix reads deep-equal to the fresh selection. projectFhContinuations shows status responded, with respondedEventRef/respondedPublicOperationEventRef equal to the two prepared events.
newCase.operationOnly: Every requested ref gets [effectful_public_invocation_truth_invalid_history, invalid_history, invocation_pair_invalid, [operationEventRef], null]. F_H facts = {invalid_history, [operationEventRef]}.
newCase.preparerGuards: Re-preparing the used ref on the completed prefix returns the combined owner's duplicate value, and on the operation-only prefix returns its invalid_history value; no second event is planned in either case. A root record without the response grant (same seed builder, responseGrant false; all gates still open) makes prepareContinuationPublicOperation throw 'requires the exact admitted run authority'. A foreign actor throws the same. A foreign responseContractRef makes prepareFhInteractionResponse throw 'requires one exact prefix-projected operation and open continuation'.
